Nora: Quick leader pulse — three items: Private GA hold points, recent latency incident summary, and Q2 cost gap. Please read and ack.

Sam: What specifically is blocking GA?

Nora: Vendor attestation pending, final MSA sign, and on-prem runbook dry-run. Vendor ETA Tue. No external comms until all clear.

Ibrahim: Short incident recap: autoscaler thrash during a burst caused p95 spikes for a subset of dedicated customers. Hotfix v2.3.2 applied to eliminate the race. Immediate mitigations: 30s deletion cooldown, deterministic eviction, extra load test. JIRA INC-2026-512 created.

Nora: Canary plan: tomorrow 09:00 PT, 10% traffic -> 50% if stable at +45m. Sam, please own canary; ops-bot will trigger fallback if errors >0.5% or p95 >2s.

ops-bot: scheduled deploy: canary/autoscaler-v2.3.2 at 2026-03-26T09:00:01Z

Sam: Acknowledged; will monitor dashboards (/dashboards/latency, /dashboards/autoscaler).

Nora: Policy note: non-PII hosted debug logs retention default reduced 90->60 days to cut storage spend. Security signed off; docs banner to follow.

Ibrahim: Cost update: infra + Optimize changes project ~7% unit-cost reduction; need ~3% more to hit Q2 target. Ops please prioritize caching tickets.

Nora: Owners: Sam (canary), Ibrahim (postmortem), Legal/CS (MSA & customer comms). I'll follow up Friday with a brief status. If anything goes wrong during canary ping me directly. :eyes:
